args.summary: The v2.3.1 deploy of checkout-api failed health checks in production with an 18% error rate. Per the runbook, the service was rolled back in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt failed partway (us-east only, due to an orchestrator error), leaving mixed versions across regions; a retry completed the rollout to v2.3.0 everywhere. Service is now healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%. Follow-up: investigate v2.3.1 regression before any redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api: rolled back from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 after health check failures
